record.title: Federal bankruptcy court and estate-administration route
record.sub: Recover or resolve a failed institution
kv: Bankruptcy Code eligibility and the applicable chapter/court process.
An eligible debtor's insolvency is governed by the Bankruptcy Code rather than a specialized bank, broker-dealer, insurer, or other resolution regime.
United States bankruptcy courts; U.S. Trustee Program; Court-appointed case trustees; Debtors in possession where the Bankruptcy Code permits

Identify the exact debtor legal entity and its eligibility. Identify the chapter, venue, court orders, estate fiduciary, and property/claim characterization. Test whether a specialized insolvency, receivership, or resolution statute applies instead.

Bankruptcy is not a catch-all: domestic banks are excluded by section 109, and specialized regimes can govern other regulated entities. A token ledger does not by itself identify estate property, perfection, custody, or priority.
U.S. Trustee Program: DOJ identifies the U.S. Trustee Program as part of the federal bankruptcy system.
